scope: Finite rereview of the 22 substantive company/startup holds from company-eligibility-closeout.json, plus main-requested catalogue and category corrections. No discovery.
coverageMeaning: All 22 source sets were reread and assessed, with targeted product, project, successor and source-publisher followups. Fourteen remain evidence limitations, not approved removals. Neither HTTP success nor a keyword matched determined eligibility.
retrievals: Public primary pages refreshed with bounded concurrency of three. Additional official pages and publisher-authored release consulted. Local captures are supplementary; exact source URLs and decisive findings are embedded here.

rows.name: Accenture Switzerland
rows.reason: The official Zurich hub release proves local software prototyping, and current myWizard material proves original group technology. Neither attributes ongoing myWizard development to the Zurich operation. This is a local-development attribution gap, not evidence that Accenture has no technology.
rows.remainingQuestion: Which current Zurich team develops a group platform or other maintained original technology?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: AutoMate Insurance AG
rows.reason: Insurance calculators, a broker portal and white-label integrations are real published offerings. The refreshed executive-solutions page and indexed team page do not identify who develops the engine; direct about-page retrieval exposes untranslated templates. No evidence establishes mere resale either.
rows.remainingQuestion: Does AutoMate maintain the insurance platform, or license its implementation from another developer?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: Blackpoints
rows.reason: Official development catalogue offers customer-specific web/mobile implementation and vendor CMS/e-commerce integration. The named FRIAC reference explicitly describes integration and maintenance of CAMAC for Fribourg; partner products are attributed to iGovPortal, Inventsys and TYPO3. Bounded catalogue review supports client-service-only exclusion, subject to main review.
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: ECOPARTS
rows.reason: Produces metal components and cooled sprue bushings using its own implemented additive/hybrid manufacturing process, with documented construction, topology optimisation and changed cooling-section manufacture versus the inherited MoldMasters process. This is substantive technical production and process development, not resale. Invention of laser sintering or exclusive patents is not required.
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: evolyze GmbH
rows.reason: The official service and project catalogues describe client data engineering, integration and bespoke implementations. The databaum case specifically improves databaum's existing ML model and data capture; it is not an evolyze product. Cotra, cantonal and Vatorex references are likewise client engagements. Recommend exclusion under the superseding criterion, not because engineering is absent.
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: Forte Digital
rows.reason: Current service catalogue and office roster describe European digital consulting and client development, but omit Switzerland. Local identity/occupancy and any local original platform development remain unconfirmed. An omitted office alone is not a closure finding.
rows.remainingQuestion: Is the listed Swiss operation current, and which original technology does that operation develop?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: icentic
rows.reason: Current icentic catalogue centres on software staffing and customer development. Its own about page identifies the shared founder and incubation role; beppo explicitly identifies itself as an icentic spin-off and says its Zurich headquarters develops digital tools. Current development ownership across these distinct entities remains unclear.
rows.remainingQuestion: Does icentic still develop the beppo platform or another original group technology, rather than only provide client development resources?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: KOCH IT
rows.reason: Adnovum's May 2026 release explicitly confirms Koch IT's April absorption merger and integration into its public-sector team. Technical capability is not in dispute. Current independent brand and continued occupancy of the mapped Winterthur location are not established.
rows.remainingQuestion: Should the Koch IT profile/location be represented as an Adnovum site, and is the exact mapped office still occupied?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: Linked Engineering
rows.reason: Official offer expressly covers mechanical design, prototypes and small-series production; the homepage refers to self-developed assemblies. All concrete references are customer product-development projects, including Durot Electric. There is substantive original engineering, but no identified continuing company technology distinct from those projects. Do not mislabel it generic IT support.
rows.remainingQuestion: Which identified assembly, process or maintained design is Linked Engineering's continuing technology rather than solely a customer deliverable?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: Mathys Partner
rows.reason: Official glare methodology describes non-point simulations, optical intensity calculations and specialist transport-safety analyses. Federal reference material corroborates simulation services, not authorship of the calculation engine. The report does not infer invention from expert use or demand a patent.
rows.remainingQuestion: Does Mathys Partner develop the simulation engine or methods, or use externally developed software to prepare expert reports?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: mecas
rows.reason: Current homepage identifies a physical-AI lab covering vision, sensors and robotics; terms describe staffing and bespoke AI/software work. The terms' generic retention of copyright is not evidence of a concrete technology programme. No named research output, model or apparatus was established.
rows.remainingQuestion: What concrete in-house physical-AI system or research output is attributable to Mecas?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: Microbe Investigations Switzerland
rows.reason: Official history identifies the Schlieren laboratory, and the about page describes a microbiology CRO/test laboratory with bacteriology, virology and entomology research/testing facilities. Retain on specialised physical laboratory infrastructure grounds analogous to the expressly approved EMVLAB rationale; propose Company to Lab for main review, without claiming an original proprietary assay.
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: onmit
rows.reason: Official software-development page offers customer-specific concepts, development and ongoing support. Its concrete Teacher Switch reference explicitly says the application was developed for the separate startup using Twilio integration; the wider catalogue is IT support, websites and UX services. Recommend exclusion based on the affirmative client-service catalogue, not a missing website.
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: Quantum Digital
rows.reason: The 2026 SelfService case explicitly attributes app development to Quantum Digital, so simple reseller-only exclusion would be unsafe. MediaLink instead uses Bertsch Innovation's mediacockpit and is presented as customer integration. Whether SelfService is maintained original company technology or solely a Debrunner-specific deliverable remains unresolved.
rows.remainingQuestion: Does Quantum Digital maintain SelfService or a reusable original application beyond the individual client implementation?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: Reasoning Labs
rows.reason: Fresh primary homepage still provides only a research ambition and the footer REASONING MACHINES INC. The identity bridge to the listed Swiss organisation and a concrete attributable research programme remain unverified. Sparse startup communication is not grounds for exclusion.
rows.remainingQuestion: What primary source ties this domain and research team to the listed Swiss legal entity/local operation?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: Scheuss & Partner
rows.reason: The current catalogue is managed Microsoft infrastructure and service bundles. publicloud Marketplace is a concrete provisioning/billing portal, but the public portal only returns a loading shell and the marketing page does not name its developer. Do not classify it as licensed white-label software without evidence.
rows.remainingQuestion: Who develops and maintains the publicloud Marketplace software?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: STEP-X
rows.reason: Step-X's own 2004 launch release distinguishes its multi-user ZOE.professional server application from the original open-source ZOE by Szwarc Consulting and describes support/maintenance. Its current solutions page still offers the professional product in cloud, hybrid and onsite configurations. An original maintained derivative qualifies; ENOVIA/Scribe resale does not invalidate that separate branch. Recent release cadence is not independently verified.
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: Swiss Robotics & Advanced Technologies
rows.reason: Homepage, solutions and vision pages describe autonomous aerial inspection and non-destructive testing, but provide no identified robot, developer team or technical demonstration sufficient to distinguish original development from integration. This is a product-attribution gap, not a dormancy claim.
rows.remainingQuestion: Which robot, control system or inspection technology has this exact company developed?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: tailorfast
rows.reason: Official about page expressly identifies its own software development; the portal offering describes a common modular native Android/iOS/web system with configurable extensions, push notifications and cloud updates. This is a maintained reusable platform offer rather than merely a list of customer integrations. The embedded demo says it is not ready, so no successful demo execution or customer deployment is claimed.
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: UMB
rows.reason: Current SAP page attributes a near-zero-downtime concept to UMB, but the described mechanism could be SAP-instance switching/configuration. Platform Builder and AI services primarily describe integration/operation. The former ubitec/UMB Solutions product business became independently owned mesoneer and cannot be attributed to current UMB.
rows.remainingQuestion: What maintained original software or technical process does current UMB develop beyond vendor configuration, independently of mesoneer?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: Voviva
rows.reason: The current Dextra case gives substantive original engineering detail and names joint development of an intake system still in development. Homepage explicitly offers bespoke project/retainer systems, not standard software. This is stronger than generic AI consulting, but the evidence does not distinguish continuing company technology from client-specific implementations.
rows.remainingQuestion: Is the Dextra system or its core maintained as Voviva technology beyond the bespoke client project?
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

rows.name: WOn-Data
rows.reason: The full current service catalogue affirmatively offers colocation, power/cooling, carrier connections, monitoring and remote hands. Its named engineers operate datacentre infrastructure; the mentioned reporting portal has no development claim. No original software/product branch is presented. Recommend exclusion under the own-technology criterion, while recognising substantive infrastructure operations rather than calling it inactive.
rows.activity: Published offering reviewed; no blanket independent activity or occupancy certification.

corrections.reason: SmartCampus explicitly undergoes continuing CrossWorks development, confirmed by its customer account of the original solution being continued and professionalised. All named product branches were checked: HS/SA is a multi-canton roadtraffic application; SwissContentCloud is an IBM-based DMS offering; KIM remains third-party CRM and does not determine company eligibility.

uNimbus followup describes hosted private-cloud operation, with Green datacentres, IBM Power infrastructure and Unimission management. Together with the previously reviewed SolarWinds-based UniVision branch this supports the service/resale recommendation. A named platform alone does not establish its development. Main has not yet approved this full-branch conclusion.
corrections.currentReason: Official company history explicitly states that development of Swiss Private Cloud uNimbus began in 2025. Green hosting, IBM infrastructure and SolarWinds-powered UniVision do not disprove original uNimbus development. The catalogue does not identify an original control-plane/software component or technical process. Prior exclusion is unsafe until this branch is resolved.

corrections.reason: Main independently reviewed official consultancy catalogue and third-party SwissGRC attribution. No production mutation authorised by this report.
Main independently reviewed official customer SAP-extension catalogue. Preserve recommendation; no production mutation.

mutationBoundary: Do not execute any operation from this report. Four new exclusion recommendations require independent main review and supported action-time confirmation. company-map-removals.json remains frozen; CrossWorks withdrawal supersedes every earlier recommendation.
supersessionNotice: Historical research only. Counts, open questions and recommendations may be stale. Use the current exclusions manifest and audit; do not execute historical operations.
